description: An out-of-range record in first position, which is defect 1 firing before anything has been written. The record's TRAN-PROC-TS begins 2021-12-31, below WS-START-DATE, so the range test at :173-174 fails on the very first pass and NEXT SENTENCE leaves the loop before 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT has ever run. No header, no detail, no total: TRANREPT is created by 0100-REPTFILE-OPEN and closed by 9100-REPTFILE-CLOSE holding nothing, which is a state no row-level expectation can describe and which the dataset-level expectation of zero rows at 133 bytes asserts instead. RETURN-CODE is 0 - an empty report is not an error here.
